claims: The 2026 UGA G-Day spring football game is scheduled for Saturday, April 18, 2026.
The 2026 UGA G-Day spring football game is scheduled at 1:00 p.m. ET.
The 2026 UGA G-Day spring football game is scheduled at Dooley Field at Sanford Stadium in Athens, GA.
The 2026 UGA G-Day spring football game will be streamed exclusively on SEC Network+ and ESPN+.
The 2026 UGA G-Day spring football game is the annual Red vs. Black scrimmage.
The annual Red vs. Black scrimmage serves as the 15th and final practice of the spring.
Tickets for the 2026 UGA G-Day spring football game were on sale starting March 30.
Tickets for the 2026 UGA G-Day spring football game cost $10.
